No silent de-contenting against the previous 1 Series

Proposal
1, implement. The general equipment theme draws 73 complaint rows with 35 wishes, mostly from repeat buyers listing features that were standard on the F40 and are now missing or optional.
Horizon
H1. Standard-content and configurator decision.
Domain
General / Cross-cutting
Markets
EU
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-F70-EU-GE-01 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

Items that loyal customers used on the previous generation (12 V socket in the boot, rear USB charging, mirror kerb tilt, dual-zone climate, fog lights, glove-box light) shall stay standard on the comparable trim, or the change shall be shown clearly at configuration.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
EUListed items standard on the M Sport trimAllOffer checkassumption
EUComplaint rows about missing standard equipment-50 % within 12 monthsCustomer feedbackassumption

    FND-F70-EU-VOC-body_equipment_overall_technology

    Customers of the BMW 1 Series (EU) raise 73 complaint rows about 'Body equipment, overall technology' (13 defects, 25 usability problems, 35 wishes) from 1 source type(s); that is 3.8% of all complaint rows in this market and 24% of what customers say about this theme.

    Figures. 300 rows: 227 likes, 73 complaints (13 defects, 25 difficult to use, 35 wants). 3.8 % of the market's 1,904 complaint rows; 24% of the theme's rows are complaints. by powertrain: ICE 300. by source: Source A 300. by country: GB 278, SE 14, FR 5, FI 2, DK 1.

    • supports FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-build_quality: Study attribute 'CN_EU_2025: build_quality' is weak (7.95), consistent with the complaints

Effort (CPM)

Share of a new vehicle generation's development effort, computed by the effort engine from the change profile and the effort model (Change Prediction Method). Every weight and link of the model is an assumption, not calibrated; the figure is a rough prioritisation factor, never money.

0.2 % of a new vehicle generation · P5 to P95 0.1 to 0.4 · adapt, kept in 100 % of the sensitivity runs · size XS · layer K0 · certification add-on no

Change profile
